title: Avril Lavigne announces the birth of her first child
summary: The singer shared the news of her daughter's arrival on Instagram today.
body:
Avril Lavigne has announced the birth of her first child, a daughter.

The Canadian singer, 42, shared the news today in a post on Instagram, her first on the platform in more than a year. She had not made her pregnancy public.

The announcement

The post included a photo of the newborn's hand and another of Lavigne holding the baby. A third showed three pairs of checkered trainers, two adult pairs and one tiny pair, lined up on a skateboard.

Lavigne did not share her daughter's name or date of birth.

Sources: Good Morning America, The Globe and Mail, CTV News.
